rec: Coins or more for boat trips (90)

st.t: Talk to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store.
s: Ok, I will get it back.

st.t: Travel to the GPDT depot in Ardougne, just south of the eastern bank, and investigate the most northeastern crate for a label.
Use the address label on the crate two squares south of the crate where you found the label.
Talk to a nearby GPDT employee.
s: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

st.t: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north east Ardougne.
s: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

st.t: Work out and enter the password for the door to the west.
FIRST long-press the stairs and choose Investigate to disable a trap, then climb the stairs.
Open the chest on the top floor and search it for the totem.
Return to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.
